description: Inside the walls of the Alcázar of Jerez, the palm-lined Patio de Armas stretches toward massive Almohad towers, the octagonal tower rising dark against the night sky. The 12th-century fortress-palace — one of the finest surviving examples of Almohad architecture in Spain — is softened by warm courtyard lamps, with the Baroque palace and the old mosque's arches shadowed nearby. On a clear 22°C night the quiet courtyard feels like the heart of old Jerez, nine centuries deep.
